text:
maria_support: Hi team — ACME (acct: acme-uk) has invoice INV-2026-134 on hold. Payment portal shows a card decline (402 card_declined) and finance says PO was submitted (PO-8891) but our billing rejected due to VAT/PO mismatch. Customer is asking for Net 60 and immediate access while they sort procurement. Invoice/internals: invoice_2026_134, payment_attempt pay_789. Can we unblock short-term?

john_finance: Saw the decline in payments logs — decline_code: do_not_honor. Also noticed tax_id missing on the invoice which caused VAT calc mismatch vs PO. For Net 60 we need legal sign-off on terms; finance can approve a temporary credit hold up to £5k if ops/legal are fine.

kevin_sales: Customer insists Net 60 is standard for their EU procurement. They uploaded a PO but billing_address on PO != account address, that's why our system refused the PO link. They can provide VAT reg number (GB999888777) and sign an addendum. Can billing team patch the invoice to match PO?

lina_engineer: I pulled billing-service logs and reproduced the failure. Repro steps: curl -s -X POST https://billing.redwood.ai/v1/payments -d '{"invoice":"invoice_2026_134","method":"card","token":"tok_XXXX"}' -> HTTP 402, body: {"code":"card_declined","decline_code":"do_not_honor"}. Backoffice shows PO present but field billing_address == null which triggers validation failure when attaching PO. Quick workaround: set billing_address from account profile, attach PO, then queue retry.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Created support ticket #SUP-5982, flagged for finance-escalation and legal-review.

john_finance: Outstanding amount = £18,450 net. VAT @20% = £3,690. Total = £22,140. If we push provisional credit beyond £5k we need exec approval.

maria_support: Customer uploaded VAT reg (GB999888777) in the support portal and agreed to sign the terms addendum within 48h. They asked we try one more manual charge after PO is attached.

kevin_sales: Please attach the PO and retry. If the card still fails, let's put them on provisional Net 60 credit (watchlist) and notify collections. Tagging @john_finance @sarah_legal @lina_engineer for approvals. :raised_hands: 

lina_engineer: Doing manual attach + retry now. Script I run:```bash
# attach PO and requeue payment
python tools/billing_attach_po.py --invoice invoice_2026_134 --po PO-8891 --billing-address "ACME LTD, 12 King St, London"
# trigger retry
curl -X POST https://billing.redwood.ai/v1/invoices/invoice_2026_134/retry_payment
```
Will post results in a minute.

sarah_legal: Reviewed the addendum draft — provisional Net 60 is acceptable if customer signs within 7 days and we have a valid VAT reg + PO. Approved conditionally. Please capture signed doc in contract-storage.

maria_support: Retry succeeded — payment gateway returned success on manual retry after PO attach, charge settled for invoice_2026_134. Customer will sign addendum and finance to note provisional credit no longer needed. Closing loop: SUP-5982 -> resolved. :tada:
